about: Contexts for `appears eval`: what's on screen, and what Appears should find (paths under demo/files). Negative scenarios should surface nothing confidently.

scenarios.name: Replying to the contractor
scenarios.title: Re: Kitchen — can you start on the 14th?
scenarios.focused:
Hi Dana,

The 14th works. Before you start, can you confirm the quote still covers moving the outlet by the window and the quartz counters? Also, do we need the city inspection before the cabinets go in?

Thanks
scenarios.visible: Dana Ruiz: We can start the kitchen on the 14th if the permit is still good. Cabinets are in.
